name: scrap_mis_report
title: Scrap MIS Report (Welded · L-Saw · Seamless)
description: Plant-wise Scrap MIS - exact logic of 'Scrap_MIS_Dashboard_Generator_v10_NoCharts.html'. Use for: '/scrap-mis-report', 'scrap MIS', 'scrap mis dashboard', 'welded / seamless scrap %', 'random %', 'BL', 'final cutting scrap', 'M2M scrap', 'L-Saw scrap', 'total scrap % welded + seamless'. NOT the job-card bucket report (/jobcardwise_scrap).
rules:
SOURCE (one view per ERP export of the tool)
1. One view per ERP file of the tool (the file name decides the slot in the tool):
   Welded (R959) -> Welded.csv: VIEW_WELDED_SCRAP_MIS_PBI
   Seamless (R960) -> Seamless.csv: VIEW_SEAMLESS_SCRAP_MIS_PBI
   Slitting (R961) -> Slitting.csv: VIEW_SLITTING_MIS_PBI
   Final cutting (R950) -> Final_Cutting.csv: VIEW_FINAL_CUTTING_SCRAP_PBI
   M2M seamless scrap (R984) -> M2M.csv: VIEW_M2M_PBI
   If VIEW_WELDED_SCRAP_MIS_PBI is not synced yet the engine uses welded-plant rows of the seamless view and says so (summary.welded_source_note) - tell the user.
2. ALWAYS use run_report_engine(skill_name='scrap_mis_report', ...). Never write SQL for this report - the engine is an exact port of the v10 HTML tool, maps the view columns to the ERP export headers itself and uploads the files into the tool. If it says 'Column(s) not found', show the user which ones and the available columns.

PERIOD
3. Month names ('Sep', 'last month', 'is mahine'), ranges or days. Month without year = latest past occurrence; current month = month to date. Nothing given -> current month to date. All quantities in MT (kg / 1000).
4. One section only when asked: 'welded', 'l-saw', 'slitting' -> section welded; 'seamless', 'BA', 'piercing', 'pilger', 'M2M' -> section seamless.

LOGIC (built into the engine - explain if asked)
5. Welded = plant WELDE; TM10 = machine TM10; Cond = plant CONDT; Slitting: Prod = Coil + Plate Received Qty, Scrap = SS Scrap / Outside Scrap Received Qty. Welded Total = Welded + TM10 + Cond + Slitting; its cutting = Welded + Cond cutting.
6. L-Saw = machine PLB1 on plant L_SAW, cutting from plant LSAW, never added into Welded Total.
7. Seamless: BA; SMLSP: EXP1 / PEEL* / all other (ALL PILGER); SMLP2: PEEL* (PEEL3) / all other (ALL PILGER); SMLST Tube; PIERC Piercing 1; PIER2 Piercing 2; M2M line = scrap only from VIEW_M2M_PBI Received Qty.
8. Final cutting: CUTTING & DEBURRING by plant; MH CUTTING SMLSP -> Piercing 1, SMLP2 -> Piercing 2; RB CUTTING SMLSP -> SMLS Pipe (PEEL), SMLP2 -> SMLS Pipe-2 (PEEL3). All WO Process rows always left out.
9. Total Issue Qty = Prod + RL + Scrap + BL. Random % = RL / Total Issue. 1st process scrap % = (Scrap + BL) / Total Issue. Cutting scrap % = Scrap / (Prod + Scrap). Total scrap % = Random % + 1st process % + cutting %. Lower scrap = better.
10. Unknown plants / processes are left out and listed under 'Left out' - say so, never re-map them.

EXPLAINING
10. When the user asks how a figure is calculated, why a total is high / does not match, or whether Total scrap % is material loss: follow the company 'Scrap MIS Calculation Guide' (knowledge file scrap_mis_calculation_guide.md) - its answer order (what, source fields, formula, illustrative example, meaning, mappings, exclusions, limitations), exact formulas and wording. Use real numbers only from the engine result; mark examples as illustrative. If the guide does not define something say: 'Report logic does not define this clearly.'
output_format:
Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers by itself: the tool's 5 KPI cards (Welded production, L-Saw, Seamless production, Final cutting output, Total scrap % Welded + Seamless) + section scrap % with ▲▼ vs previous month, the Welded and Seamless tables exactly like the tool (MT, Random %, 1st process %, cutting, Total scrap %) with charts, left-out list, and the company's own HTML tool with this period's 5 files already uploaded (Summary / Month-wise / Compare views, Excel / PDF / HTML downloads work).
FORMATS: default [table, chart, dashboard]. 'excel' or 'pdf' only when the user asks; 'data' = the 5 ERP-format CSV files (zip).

SUMMARY in the user's language, 4-6 short lines:
- Total scrap % (Welded + Seamless) with change vs previous month in pts, and its split random + process + cutting.
- Welded, L-Saw and Seamless production (MT) and each section's total scrap %.
- Highest total-scrap line and highest final-cutting scrap line (from summary).
- Anything left out (summary.left_out), else skip.
- Last line '✅ Checks passed' if every check is ok, else '⚠️ ' + failed checks.
Mention: 'Open the 🖥️ dashboard for month-wise and compare views.'
example_output: KPI cards: Welded production 1,736.77 MT | L-Saw 318.56 MT | Seamless production 4,802.95 MT | Final cutting 2,669.02 MT (scrap 5.93%) | Total scrap % 15.16% (random 1.28 + process 7.95 + cutting 5.93). Then Welded and Seamless tables + charts, left-out list and the 🖥️ dashboard.
